title: A website only you can open
summary: Open a door that only your own laptop can use, not your phone or anyone on the Wi-Fi.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:8095` opens it
tasks.hint: Its door on the laptop is 8095, and nginx listens on 80 inside.

tasks.title: The door only lets in your own laptop
tasks.hint: Put the address in front of the port: `-p 127.0.0.1:8095:80`. The door can't be changed on a running container, so `docker rm -f private-site` and run it again.
